symbols.name: strongly_connected_components
symbols.note: Iterative Tarjan's algorithm returning tuple of sorted components.

claims.text: structcore had **no cycle detection at all**.
claims.why: No code from structcore is provided to verify this claim.

claims.text: ``topology.spectral_partition`` builds ``nx.Graph()`` and labels itself 'undirected projection of directed import edges'. It discards DIRECTION, which is the only thing a cycle is made of.
claims.why: No code for topology.spectral_partition is present in this chunk.

claims.text: ``graph.py``'s ``seen = {rel}`` -- a cycle *guard*, so a walk terminates. Not a detector.
claims.why: No code for graph.py is present.
Only imports are from typing and __future__; no non-stdlib imports yet, but the rest of the file could introduce them. Iterative algorithm is confirmed for this function but not for others.

claims.text: deterministic, because these outputs get committed to receipts and diffed between runs. Set iteration order is not a basis for a receipt.
claims.why: No code in this chunk shows output ordering or receipts; the function uses sorted() which is deterministic.

claims.text: Every SCC of the directed graph, largest first, each sorted.
claims.why: The function returns tuple of tuples, but sorting by size and lexicographic order is not implemented in this chunk; likely done later or in caller.

claims.text: Nodes are every key plus every target, so a module that is only ever imported still appears -- a leaf is a component of one, and omitting it would make the component count depend on which side of an edge a module happens to sit.
claims.why: The code collects nodes from both keys and their targets (lines 45-52), ensuring all nodes appear.

claims.text: Ordering is total and content-derived: by descending size, then lexicographically by the component's own members.
claims.why: The function returns a tuple but does not sort components in this chunk; sorting must happen elsewhere.
The implementation uses an explicit stack (work list) and avoids recursion.

observations.what: The module docstring contains detailed audit findings about structcore's lack of cycle detection, but no supporting code is present in this chunk.
The function strongly_connected_components is partially implemented; it collects nodes and performs iterative Tarjan but the component sorting (descending size, lexicographic) is not visible.
